title: Boundary wall maximum height on lots less than 100 m2 (R100-SL, 13 m)
text: Table 2.10a Modified provisions for housing on lots less than 100m2. 3.4 Lot boundary setbacks (1), C3.4.5: Boundary walls permitted: - behind the street setback; and - to a maximum boundary wall height of 13m. (1) Where development abuts an adjoining property not coded R100-SL, the modified provisions of Table 2.10a do not apply.

replaces.note: current Part C Table 2.10a; register ch2-065: 13 m wall height R100-SL via draft Table 2.10a

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 2.10a cites C3.4.5 (the draft's numbering slip; the provision modifies C3.4.4/Table 3.4c). Footnote 1 is encoded with proposed fact adjoining.all_coded_r100_sl: where any adjoining property is not R100-SL this rule is excluded and no deemed-exempt boundary wall height is encoded for the lot (the Table 3.4c R50+ 7 m rule would be the likely fallback; verify). Length and boundary-count limits at R100-SL are not stated.

verified.note: Value 13m confirmed on p25 and in Table 2A (p7). The Table 2.10a row cites C3.4.5 although it modifies the C3.4.4/Table 3.4c height, and the page does not say which height applies under footnote 1 when an adjoining lot is not R100-SL.
